open_questions: Owner: a workshop unlocked by skill (e.g. MIN_1, MIL_1) can only be built from the Space Storage view, which needs FND_STORAGE and an established storage. Until then nothing shows anywhere, so the player may not realise workshops live in the station. Want a hint (planet panel line or skill text)? Needs a story id.
